pages.title: Rogue Apprentices
pages.text: Not everyone who wakes to magic finds a teacher. Some wander the night alone, half-trained and dangerous.$(br2)$(l)Rogue Apprentices$() keep their distance and throw $(l)Sparks$(). Get close and they answer with $(l)Frost Nova$(); hurt them badly and they $(l)Blink$() away.$(br2)Their pockets hold Dull Shards, and if you are awakened, their notes are worth $(l)a point of Knowledge$().

pages.title: Hollow Cultists
pages.text: Something in the Hollow still has followers.$(br2)$(l)Hollow Cultists$() hurl $(l)Void Lances$() that leave corruption behind, and call $(l)shades$() to fight for them.$(br2)They carry Void Shards, and very rarely, a $(item)Lost Page$() taken from the towers.$(br2)$(o)Warding magic was made for moments like these.$()
